{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZhK_JQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDIL3g", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 47, "title": "Correct XRRigidTransform conversion, bindings and matrix lifetime", "body": "## Problem

At `f48074c0c9fd2487ebac6d830ba6a1fd1c206a1c`, `geometry.ts` reads raw transform arguments repeatedly, rejects numeric strings and mishandles null dictionaries/components. TypeScript `readonly` fields remain writable JavaScript properties. The matrix never regenerates after buffer detachment, and inverse/offset calculations consume the exported mutable array. Reference offsets also reject genuine transforms from separately injected same-origin realms through `instanceof`.

These defects affect application-authored navigation and transforms returned throughout the API. Existing basic transform passes do not cover these cases.

## Expected outcome

Provide correctly converted, branded transform values with stable readonly attributes, usable matrix buffers and consistent inverse/reference-offset behavior. Complete this transform prerequisite while retaining the remaining pose/view defects and every deferred module in the fixed goal.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Relevant files are `api/geometry.ts`, `interface-brand.ts`, transform consumers, `CustomWebXRPolyfill.ts` and the generated polyfill bundle. Existing shared-brand/event patterns and Chromium/Firefox reference-space drivers provide reusable infrastructure; no dependency upgrade is needed.

The [Device CRD, 9 June 2026, §§6.2 and 8](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/) defines transform construction, inverse identity, matrix regeneration and reference offsets. Apply the pinned [WebIDL conversion/binding algorithms](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs). Readonly attributes do not require frozen typed-array elements. [Chromium at f842f52](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/f842f52ef39fd97b449eb27cff414bf05a98ddce/third_party/blink/renderer/modules/xr/xr_rigid_transform.cc) separates internal transform data from its exported matrix array; its reference-space implementation consumes that internal data.

Applicability: standalone transforms, Quest VR/MR and Android AR, including inline sessions. No new feature descriptor. Integration fixtures use default `viewer`; immersive floor/bounds fixtures explicitly request `local-floor` and `bounded-floor`. Preserve the current viewer-only inline policy.

The pinned [Three.js r186 teleport example](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8/examples/webxr_vr_teleport.html) constructs transforms for reference-space navigation. Source inspection establishes consumer relevance, not a runtime pass.

All 46 existing Issues/PRs are closed. #39/#41 addressed reference-space requests and shutdown, rather than this value contract. #11’s closure explicitly retained broader WebIDL gaps. The October 21 report records five adapted WPT files passing on Chromium 156.0.8078.4; that historical result supplies no execution evidence for the new cases.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Convert both `DOMPointInit` arguments completely before constructor validation: defaults, null/undefined dictionaries, inherited members, one ordered `w,x,y,z` read per dictionary, numeric coercion and propagated getter/conversion exceptions. Cover numeric strings, explicit null components, primitive dictionaries, Symbols and BigInts. Preserve applicable `TypeError` and non-normalizable-quaternion `InvalidStateError` behavior.
- [ ] Expose `position`, `orientation`, `matrix` and `inverse` as enumerable/configurable prototype getters without setters. Reject forged/proxy receivers. Test strict/sloppy assignment and SameObject identities. Genuine same-origin iframe/popup transforms and borrowed getters work with allocations in the transform’s realm.
- [ ] Preserve rotation-then-translation, metre units and reciprocal inverse identity. Repeated matrix reads reuse the attached array; transferring its buffer produces a fresh equivalent 16-element array on the next read. Cover detachment before/after inverse creation and transforms returned by pose queries. Retained values remain readable after frame/session completion.
- [ ] Keep exported matrix elements mutable while separating internal geometric state: element writes must not rewrite points or corrupt inverse/reference-offset calculations. Demonstrate this alongside detachment using the inspected Chromium implementation as corroboration; do not claim native opaque-resource enforcement.
- [ ] Complete the affected reference-offset integration: genuine cross-realm transform arguments, receiver/argument errors, fresh base-realm offsets, nested translation/rotation, bounded subclass and inverse-transformed bounds. Validate application-visible pose changes in active frames with documented numerical tolerances. Preserve session ownership and completed request/shutdown acceptance.
- [ ] Extend a focused fixture using the existing Chromium/Firefox drivers and execute it for all three immersive profiles plus inline on both device profiles. Include identifiable rendered geometry before/after an offset, correct stereo/mono presentation and clean teardown. Document the focused command; no generic application-suite rerun is required.
- [ ] Retain the four transform assertion files at WPT `e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3`, documenting setup adaptations and any evidence-backed discrepancy. The Coordinator runs `npm run build:firefox`, `npm run test:wpt`, the focused commands and `git diff --check`. Record tested revisions/bundles, browser/tool versions, actual outcomes, failures, skips and unperformed checks; inspect generated changes and update the inventory/reproduction guidance.

The Coordinator owns implementation, tests, normal PR review and merge. Add no independent AI re-review. Correct mistaken AI requirements without human approval by retaining the original assumption, correction, pinned primary source and rationale in the Issue/PR. Preserve the goal and meaningful acceptance; unfinished code or failures do not justify weakening them.

## Optional validation

Execute the unchanged pinned Three.js teleport example as additional consumer evidence. This is separate from the mandatory focused rendering fixture.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
